rationale: A small script change closes a verified coverage hole before expensive native QA.
revisit_trigger: Review the implementation and a fresh use of the corrected path; recurrence remains actionable.
body: Make the normal root typecheck include apps/studio/tsconfig.json, without launching Electron. Keep the existing checks. Prove a temporary Studio-only type error fails the normal command, then remove it and verify clean code passes. Update the documented normal check so reviewers need no special reminder. Evidence: LUX-P91 event3034; current package.json and tsconfig.json. This does not replace graphical QA. Checklist: implement; independent review; verify normal command; land.
title: Include Studio in the standard typecheck
observation: P91 seq3034 records an actual Studio props ReferenceError after root checks passed. Current root typecheck runs tsconfig.json and examples only; tsconfig.json excludes apps/studio.
inferred_cause: The normal root command does not cover the renderer application.
